question: Should OpenClaw adopt `state:persist` and its gateway/bridge methods as a permanent Workspaces widget contract, then ship `builtin:notes` as its first trusted consumer?
rationale: This expands a plugin-facing capability, untrusted-widget security boundary, gateway API, and persistent SQLite model; implementation review cannot decide whether that permanent product contract is wanted.

options.title: Sponsor staged landing
options.body: Approve the contract, review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 first, then rebase and finish this narrower notes PR.

options.title: Keep persistence internal
options.body: Limit persistence to trusted built-ins for now and defer the custom-widget capability and bridge contract until a later API decision.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave both persistence and notes out of Workspaces until the broader roadmap at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 is explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged landing
recommendation.body: Approve the contract, review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 first, then rebase and finish this narrower notes PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from the explicit security-sensitive stack engagement and repository product ownership context.
